name: Michael Cohen

summary.text: Michael Cohen was a Trump Organization executive and Donald Trump's personal attorney. On August 21, 2018 he pleaded guilty in the Southern District of New York to an eight-count information charging tax evasion, false statements to a bank and campaign finance violations arising from payments to two women during the 2016 campaign. On November 29, 2018 he pleaded guilty before the Special Counsel to making false statements to Congress about the Trump Tower Moscow project, which the Mueller report records he had discussed with the Kremlin press office in January 2016. He was sentenced on December 12, 2018 to three years in prison. In 2024 he was the prosecution's central witness at Trump's New York trial, which ended in conviction on 34 counts of falsifying business records. The Felix Sater file on this site holds the Moscow project record; this file holds Cohen's pleas and sentence.

facts.claim: On November 29, 2018 Cohen pleaded guilty in Manhattan federal court to one count of making false statements to Congress, admitting that his August 2017 letter to the House and Senate intelligence committees falsely said the Trump Tower Moscow project ended in January 2016 and was not discussed extensively within the company, when discussions continued into June 2016; the information said the lies were meant to minimize links between the project and Individual 1.
facts.quote: The Moscow Project ended in January 2016 and was not discussed extensively with others in the Company.

facts.claim: On December 12, 2018 Judge Pauley sentenced Cohen to three years in prison: 36 months on the Southern District case and two months on the Special Counsel's case, served concurrently, with restitution of $1.4 million, forfeiture of $500,000 and a fine.

facts.claim: The Mueller report (volume I) records that candidate Trump signed a letter of intent for Trump Tower Moscow by November 2015 and that in January 2016 Trump Organization executive Michael Cohen emailed and spoke about the project with the office of Russian government press secretary Dmitry Peskov.

facts.claim: In May 2024 Cohen testified for several days as the prosecution's central witness at Donald Trump's New York criminal trial, describing the Stormy Daniels payment he made and said Trump directed and later reimbursed; the defense attacked his credibility over his 2017 false statement to Congress. The jury found Trump guilty on all 34 counts of falsifying business records.
